items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: "a man up in his 50s. Whereas the last time I was there and I listened to the other band, and what's his name, the band leader before that died? Leon Kellner?"

ctx.x: And they had Emory Thompson on trumpet.

They had a black piano man that I didn't know, a man up in his 50s. Whereas the last time I was there and I listened to the other band, and what's his name, the band leader before that died? Leon Kellner? No, after Kellner.
